title: Facility Manager: Permit status and expiring permits
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: Show me our permit status and any expiring soon

answer.question: Show me our permit status and any expiring soon
answer.answer:
Here's your portfolio snapshot (via the permit tracking agent):

**Overview:** 240 active permits, 63 expiring in the next 120 days, 8 of those critical (<30 days).

**Critical (<30 days):**
| Facility | Permit Type | Days Left |
|---|---|---|
| Imperial Valley Solar | Air Quality | 18 |
| Reno Wind Farm | Environmental | 22 |
| Phoenix Solar | Water Use | 26 |
| Bakersfield Solar | Hazmat | 28 |
| Tehachapi Wind | Avian Protection | 29 |
| Palm Springs Wind | Noise Variance | 29 |
| Yuma Solar | Grading | 29 |
| Mojave Storage | Fire Code | 29 |

**Exposure:** $2.34M total renewal cost across the 63 expiring permits; $47M in production at risk if the criticals lapse.

Note: this is a synthetic register — verify with the issuing authority before acting. Want me to prepare the emergency renewal package (draft only, nothing submitted) for the 8 critical ones?
